Intervention.title: Representation regarding early publication of Final-year MBBS results
Intervention.description:
The College Union ’26, has submitted representations to KUHS and the Directorate of Medical Education seeking early evaluation and publication of the Final-Year MBBS results to facilitate timely registration and internship formalities.

The Union has also requested  early commencement of House Surgency and interim deployment of NAJRs to ensure adequate resident manpower and a smooth transition between the outgoing and incoming batches, thereby maintaining uninterrupted patient care.

Intervention.title: Representation regarding Hostel Library & 24/7 Study Room Facility
Intervention.description: The Union submitted a formal representation to the Principal requesting the installation of air conditioning and 24/7 lighting/Wi-Fi access in the Men's and Women's hostel reading rooms prior to university exams.

Intervention.title: Request for Immediate Repair of OPD Block Elevator & Ramp Access
Intervention.description: Official letter submitted to the Medical Superintendent highlighting difficulties faced by wheel-chair bound patients and clinical postings students due to non-functioning elevators.

Intervention.title: Memorandum on Stipend Disbursal Schedule for PG Residents & House Surgeons
Intervention.description: Official petition addressed to the Directorate of Medical Education (DME) ensuring timely monthly credit of stipends for senior and junior resident doctors.

Intervention.title: Representation regarding the delay in E Grantz Scholarship
Intervention.description: The Union has informed the Principal of the issue of delay in E Grantz Scholarship regarding mess refund for SC/ST students and Tuition fee refund for OBC students and that if the issue is not resolved immediately, protesting measures will be taken. Following the Representation, the Principal has given the assurance to take the needed measures.

Intervention.title: Representation regarding the proposed increase in working hours of JRs under the DRP
Intervention.description: The College Union submitted a representation to the Deputy Superintendent, GGH Kozhikode, highlighting concerns regarding the proposed increase in working hours of Junior Residents under the DRP. The representation requested reconsideration of the proposed arrangement, considering the additional workload it may place on residents.
